_doc: This bot's Revenue OS settings: the business that sells Revenue Partnerships 3.0 and the Revenue OS. Names of things only: no keys, no contact lists, no partner names, no private figures. Agent state: on, test, paused, partial, missing, off. Everything starts on test or off; nothing has run on a Grok bot.
offer: The core email is the fractional job (fractional/MESSAGES.md): Dream 100, Dream 500 and cold leads. Partners, SpeakerAgent, content, and AEO and SEO carry the partnerships message (OFFER.md)
icp: Fractional job: owners and founders of a few small and mid-size companies. Partnerships message: small businesses and solopreneurs

dream-100.waits_on: the Dream 100 list, given at intake

dream-500.waits_on: the Dream 500 list, given at intake

partners.waits_on: the sending tool for partner email at volume

speaker.waits_on: the SpeakerAgent keys and pitch details

sales-crm.waits_on: the CRM key and crm-writes: on

cold-email.waits_on: the audience and the daily number, given at intake

lead-radar.waits_on: the dashboard password (the address is in the settings), the Skool and Whop group links and a signed-in browser, and a spend line for paid reads

aeo-seo.waits_on: the RankSpot key and the site named at intake

coordinate_with: the Revenue OS template's main chat
